However, significant issues exist with the motorcycles: (1) Taxonomy mismatch - they are standard straddle-frame motorcycles with exposed engines and footpegs, not motor scooters with step-through frames and floorboards as defined in the taxonomy. (3) The violin scale is surreal but internally consistent. The primary authenticity deductions come from the motorcycle taxonomy mismatch and grounding artifacts.
